description: This file defines a base class for smart turn analysis using ML models, including configuration parameters, state management, audio buffering, and prediction logic for end-of-turn detection in speech processing.

classes.name: SmartTurnParams
classes.description: Configuration parameters for smart turn analysis, including silence timeout, pre-speech buffer, and max segment duration.

classes.name: SmartTurnTimeoutException
classes.description: Exception raised when smart turn analysis times out.

classes.name: BaseSmartTurn
classes.description: Abstract base class for smart turn analyzers using ML models, managing audio buffering, turn detection, and prediction interface.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the smart turn analyzer with optional sample rate and configuration parameters.

methods.name: append_audio
methods.description: Appends raw audio data and speech detection flag, updates internal state, and determines if turn has ended.

methods.name: analyze_end_of_turn
methods.description: Asynchronously analyzes current audio buffer to determine if turn has ended, returning state and metrics.

methods.name: update_vad_start_secs
methods.description: Updates the VAD start seconds timestamp.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Resets the internal state of the turn analyzer.

methods.name: _clear
methods.description: Internal method to clear state based on turn completion status.

methods.name: _process_speech_segment
methods.description: Processes the buffered audio segment with ML model to predict turn end, returning state and metrics.

methods.name: _predict_endpoint
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented by subclasses for ML-based end-of-turn prediction from audio data.
